description: SP1 of the u(q₀) spin-part derivation (#4401 continuation of #4391). Tests the geometric fibre-spin candidate u = ln q₀ + i·(ln q₀/2) (fibre holonomy q_b=e^{i·ln q₀/2}, |q_b|=1) under Im 𝔙₄₁=(√3/4)(Re²u−Im²u). Fibre spin angle ln q₀/2 < boost ln q₀ ⇒ Im u<Re u ⇒ Im 𝔙₄₁>0 at both anchors ⇒ cannot reach S(proton)<0: smooth boost+fibre-spin REFUTED (scope-(a)). Diagonal-crossing needs Im u>Re u=ln q₀ (even full fibre angle only reaches the diagonal, Im 𝔙=0). ⇒ the sign-flip spin part must be NON-smooth/resonance + hypersensitive (SP2, open). No fit, no c_k, no instance.
